resources.name: Experimental input data for CsCl, CsBr, CsI

access.notes: Provided as a downloadable dataset within the instruction (input_data.csv). Contains lattice constant a, ionic radii r1 and r2, isothermal SOE constants C11, C12, C44 (in 10^11 dyn/cm^2), and dK'/dp (dimensionless) for CsCl, CsBr, CsI.

resources.notes: Values from Chang & Barsch (1967), Kittel (1953), and Sysio (1969). All publicly available.
